# Write-up figure captions (generated by `writeup/figs/make_figs.py`, 200 dpi PNG)

**F1 — `F1_graded_ladder.png`.** Our graded adjusted score by submission date (log scale; labelled rungs v0 3.93e-7 → v59_p05 4.92e-9, grey dots the other graded entries), against the public leader at 1.40e-9 (board read 2026-10-12, V11 §1; the feed read 2026-10-09 gave 1.454e-9) and the 3.9–4.4e-9 cluster band (band as given in the brief; `PROGRESS.md` 2026-10-07 read it at 4.06–4.09e-9), with the three phases (method, cost ladder, floor) shaded. Source: `PROGRESS.md` submissions table and "GRADED" lines, every value re-verified against that file on 2026-10-12. Gate: graded ledger (§1).

**F2 — `F2_error_origin_by_layer.png`.** Share of the final-layer MSE by layer of origin, gain_l × MSE(fresh_l) normalised (net 0, uncorrected f64 chain without the §5 closure, K = 2 gates); the last five layers carry 75 % on net 0 (75–79 % across nets 0/2/4), layers ≤ 8 together sum to 12 % from the digitised table, NOT the 6–8 % Lens B states in prose (its last-five figure, 75 %, does reproduce; the ≤ 8 discrepancy is flagged, not resolved). Source: digitised from the prose table in `research/review/LENS_B_math.md` §1 (the scratch `/tmp/claude/p2_state.npz` holds only m2/Φ/a, not fresh/gain, so no machine-readable file exists). Gate: Lens B §1 (adjoint budget; V10 §6.2).

**F3 — `F3_closure_on_off_v58ne.png`.** Per-net raw-MSE ratio, κ4 response closure OFF / ON on the cited v58_ne (VALID-20, fresh-process chunks), sorted; 17 of 20 nets are worse with the closure off, pooled 1.0327 raw (1.0309 adjusted). Source: `research/rebuild/ladder/v58_ne_noclose_vs_v58_ne_screen_valid.json` (`rung_data.valid`, 20 base/cand rows). Gate: G-RB66.

**F4 — `F4_rb68_delta_structure.png`.** Top: norm share of the next-layer D21 read carried by the (1,1,1)-induced part Δ (`share_off` = ‖off Δ‖/‖off Tz‖), 0.40–0.49 at every layer 2–14 with no depth trend; bottom: fraction of Δ's energy in its top-32 singular directions (`delta_top32_energy`), 0.31 at layer 2 rising to 0.72–0.78 at layers 13–14 against the pre-registered ≤ 0.15. FIT nets 0/2/4, uncorrected lean f64 age-6 chain. Source: `research/rb67/rb67_slice.jsonl` (39 rows). Gate: G-RB68 (LENS_F §3; V10 §11.1).

**F0 — `F0_oracle_noise_bias.png`.** Monte-Carlo noise in a sampled-truth oracle inflates the MSE ratio it reads; the split-half extrapolation to zero noise (r∞ = 2·full − mean(A,B)) removes it. (a) Pooled raw-MSE ratio vs noise level (1 = full mean, 2 = one half, 5 = ±2 dose; the dose exists for σ² only) for the all-layer σ² oracle (0.776 → 0.511, 90 % CI 0.438–0.581) and the known-answer control, which must read 0 and reads 0.305 raw but 0.002 (−0.043–0.046) extrapolated; (b) uncorrected vs corrected for σ² all layers, σ² layers 11–15 (0.710 → 0.635 [0.589, 0.680]) and the control, CIs from a between-net bootstrap over six nets (tails understated; uncorrected bars have no CI in the files). Source: `research/rb119/ci119.json` (and `ci119.out`, `tab119.out`), recomputed by `make_f0_oracle_bias.py` from `research/rb117/results_seat.jsonl` and `research/rb119/results_{half_on,half_off,dose,L1115}.jsonl`. Gate: G-RB119.
